benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Lifetime Free option from Indian Bank suited for super-premium users.
highlights: This card is completely free for Indian Bank customers. No joining fees or annual fees are taken from the cardholders.

The card has an excellent cashback facility. For every ₹ 100 spent via the card, 50 paise is credited to the account. Customers can use this cashback to redeem rewards. Minimum ₹ 500 must be used for redemption.
The card comes with an interest-free credit period ranging from 15 days to maximum 45 days.
The maximum credit limit on the card is ₹ 20,000.
Customers can withdraw cash from ATMs across the country, whenever they are in a need for hard cash. Up to 25% of credit limit can be withdrawn in a month.
insurance_cover: Indian Bank Bharat Credit Cardholders receive the complimentary insurance cover too, where they are secured financially in case of fraud purchase, hospitalisation due to an accident, death in air accidents etc.
